title: Derived vector anchors for the DGR Figure 5 isotherm above the critical temperature

edition.name: DeWolfe--Gubser--Rosen arXiv source archive v2
edition.citation: O. DeWolfe, S. S. Gubser, and C. Rosen, Phys. Rev. D 83, 086005 (2011)
edition.license: arXiv non-exclusive distribution license; derived numerical facts only

conventions.name: coordinates
conventions.value: mu_BH is the dimensionless abscissa and rho_source_figure5 is the dimensionless ordinate in the source black-hole variables
conventions.rationale: This source-artwork coordinate is intentionally distinct from the canonical holographic density rho_canonical_BH = q/2; no physical-unit conversion or axis rescaling is applied.

conventions.name: absolute ordinate comparison
conventions.value: blocked because no public source resolves the map from rho_source_figure5 to rho_canonical_BH
conventions.rationale: The approved reference anchors remain usable as a source record, but they cannot enter an absolute-density acceptance gate until the source ordinate dictionary is resolved.

conventions.name: temperature label
conventions.value: the source labels this panel only as T > T_c
conventions.rationale: The exact outer-panel temperature is not published; the current canonical-topology map does not fit it to the blocked source-ordinate anchors.

conventions.name: anchor extraction
conventions.value: PDF tick coordinates define affine axis maps; filled blue vector points are isolated, sorted in rho_source_figure5, and linearly interpolated at the twelve frozen rho_source_figure5 anchors
conventions.rationale: The extracted public-source panel aboveTcRhoMu.pdf has SHA-256 c6a56d588ee5491c2e06359d3d718b8fd21a24ebcf4f888b796a0a6db87d0719; raw artwork is not redistributed.

conventions.name: data boundary
conventions.value: only derived numerical anchors from the source model path are included
conventions.rationale: The record contains no source artwork, third-party data, local paths, claim that a HoloForge calculation has passed, or claim that rho_source_figure5 equals rho_canonical_BH.

transformations.expression: mu_BH = 0.765 + 0.005 (x - 62.452)/(101.434 - 62.452); rho_source_figure5 = 18 - 2 (y - 20.2424)/(38.8194 - 20.2424); mu_BH(rho_source_anchor) is piecewise-linear interpolation of the sorted filled-blue path
transformations.description: Map public PDF user-space coordinates to the Figure 5 above-T_c axes and interpolate the path center line at the frozen rho_source_figure5 values.
transformations.uncertainty_propagation: No statistical uncertainty is inferred. The anchors remain frozen, while their max-absolute and RMS comparison to canonical density is explicitly blocked by the unresolved source-ordinate dictionary.
